devon: Heads up — after the NCCL package bump to 2.28.3 in us-east1 inference pool we're seeing ~0.6% of multi-GPU inference jobs hang during collective ops (all-reduce/allgather). Spotted at ~10:12 UTC on a few A100 nodes (driver 535.113, CUDA 12.2).

sanjay: Oncall here — can you paste node IDs and a couple of job IDs? Any kernel oops or dmesg lines?

devon: Nodes: us-east1-inf-23, us-east1-inf-24, us-east1-inf-27. Jobs: inf-3245, inf-3248. No kernel oops but dmesg has repeated noisy nv driver messages on node24: `kernel: nvidia 0000:65:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed`. nccl-tests repro: `NCCL WARN <...> timeout at 120000 ms` — allgather hangs on 3/4 runs.

maria: Runtime: we started seeing tail latency regressions in allreduce after the bump. Are those nodes using NVLINK P2P? Any PCIe fallback observed?

devon: Yes NVLINK is enabled. Quick local workaround: exported `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` on a repro node and the hangs disappeared, but throughput fell ~18%. `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` did *not* stop the hangs.

lia: Infra note — fully rolling back the package across the pool is nontrivial without capacity impact. Us-east pool is ~88% utilized; draining 3 nodes will increase queuing. We can route some traffic to us-west, but that would add cross-region latency and egress cost.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Release 2026-03-05 nccl-2.28.3 deployed to pool us-east1 at 10:05 UTC by @deploy-pipeline

sanjay: Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) cordon the 3 suspect nodes 2) restart affected inference workers with `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` env for a canary subset 3) monitor for 30min. Maria — can runtime push a feature flag to inject that env for 5% of traffic?

maria: Yes — I can flip a canary in ~15m for 5% traffic and collect perf traces. I'll run `nccl-tests --gtest_filter=Allgather --gtest_repeat=10` on repro nodes and upload logs to /tmp/nccl-repro-2005.log. Also enabling `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO`.

devon: One extra datapoint: node24 had a kpatch at 09:58 UTC (live kernel patch). dmesg on that node shows `module nvidia: version magic` mismatch warnings in one session. Could be driver/kernel ABI interaction after the patch.

lia: Checking our kpatch schedule now. Node24 was indeed live-patched to kernel 5.19.23-rt-xyz; rolling that back needs a maintenance window. Short-term: evict pods from node24 and stop scheduling there.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1427 to track: repro artifacts, rollback plan, capacity shift, and postmortem.

sanjay: Plan agreed: 1) cordon/evict nodes 23/24/27 (lia) 2) apply runtime canary with `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` (maria) 3) collect traces & nccl-tests (devon/maria) 4) if canary stable for 30m, expand; else rollback package in off-hours. Owners assigned: lia, maria, devon. I'll own the incident channel.

devon: I'll attach strace/gdb backtraces and the `nccl-tests` outputs into INFRA-1427. Note: repro requires multi-GPU pinned job, so please don't kill the job until I capture the traces.

maria: Pushing canary now. Will post timestamp and dashboard links once live. If we see canary failures we'll automatically revert to previous config and scale traffic to us-west1.

lia: I'll start cordoning the nodes now and schedule evictions respecting pod disruption budgets.

devon: :thumbsup: tagging @oncall for visibility. Will follow up with logs shortly.
